description:
The AI/ML Engineer is a hands-on technical role within Dematic’s Shared Technical Services team, responsible for building, deploying, integrating, and operating production AI solutions across the enterprise.

This is a builder role, not a strategy, governance, or primarily research-oriented position. The engineer will work directly with business teams, AI solution architects, data engineers, product leads, and enterprise technology teams to turn prioritized AI opportunities into secure, reliable, scalable solutions that operate in real business workflows.

The role spans traditional machine learning, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, APIs, workflow automation, and related AI engineering patterns. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable writing code, troubleshooting integrations, evaluating models, building pipelines, deploying services, and supporting solutions once they are in production. 
 We offer: 
 •        Career Development
 •        Competitive Compensation and Benefits 
 •        Pay Transparency 
 •        Global Opportunities 

 Learn More Here: https://www.dematic.com/en-us/about/careers/what-we-offer  

 Dematic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. 

 This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

 The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $133,000 -$180,000 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.
 
 Tasks and Qualifications: 
 What You Will Do: 

 Build Production AI Solutions 
 Design, develop, test, and deploy production-grade AI and machine learning applications.
 Translate prototypes and proofs of concept into reliable, maintainable production solutions.
 Build AI services, APIs, backend components, and integrations connecting AI capabilities to enterprise applications and workflows.
 Develop solutions using large language models, machine learning models, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, and other AI technologies.
 Write clean, testable, maintainable Python and related application code.
 Take direct technical ownership for assigned solutions from development through production deployment.
 
 Build Generative AI and Agentic Solutions 
 Build LLM-powered applications using prompting, structured outputs, tool/function calling, embeddings, vector search, and RAG.
 Develop AI agents that can reason across business information, call enterprise tools and APIs, and execute multi-step workflows.
 Build retrieval pipelines over structured and unstructured enterprise information.
 Implement evaluation mechanisms for retrieval quality, groundedness, answer quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
 Experiment with models and architectures, but rapidly convert successful experiments into production-ready implementations.
 
 Integrate AI Into Enterprise Workflows 
 Connect AI solutions with enterprise platforms, applications, APIs, data sources, and business processes.
 Build integrations that allow AI capabilities to operate inside existing user workflows rather than as disconnected demonstrations.
 Work with Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, enterprise APIs, data platforms, and other approved technologies where appropriate.
 Collaborate with enterprise application and platform teams to integrate AI capabilities with systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Databricks, Snowflake, SharePoint, Teams, and other business platforms.
 
 Productionize and Operate AI 
 Build CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes for AI applications and models.
 Implement production monitoring for availability, latency, errors, model behavior, token consumption, quality, and cost.
 Establish appropriate logging, tracing, alerting, versioning, and observability.
 Implement model and prompt versioning, evaluation, rollback, and release-management practices.
 Diagnose and resolve production issues across models, data, APIs, infrastructure, retrieval pipelines, and application code.
 Improve solutions based on production usage and user feedback.
 
 Engineer for Enterprise Requirements 
 Build solutions that meet enterprise security, privacy, responsible AI, architecture, and data-handling requirements.
 Implement authentication, authorization, secrets management, access controls, logging, and appropriate data protections.
 Design AI components for reuse where multiple business solutions require similar capabilities.
 Document technical architecture, dependencies, interfaces, operational procedures, and known limitations.
 Ensure solutions can be supported by teams other than the original developer.
 
 Work Across Business Domains 
 Shared Technical Services operates as a reusable engineering capability across Dematic rather than as an engineering team for one business function.  
 The engineer will therefore:
 Move between prioritized AI initiatives as business demand changes.
 Become productive quickly in unfamiliar business domains.
 Work directly with business SMEs to understand processes, data, and technical requirements.
 Partner with AI solution architects and product leads to determine practical implementation approaches.
 Identify reusable components and patterns instead of repeatedly building one-off solutions.
 Provide technical estimates and surface delivery risks early.
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
 5+ years of hands-on software, machine learning, data, or AI engineering experience.
 Demonstrated experience deploying software, ML, or AI solutions into production environments, not solely developing prototypes or analytical models.
 Strong Python development skills.
 Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating systems.
 Hands-on experience with modern AI/ML frameworks and libraries.
 Practical experience developing applications with large language models.
 Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, or equivalent GenAI patterns.
 Experience with Git-based software development, automated testing, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.
 Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments.
 Understanding of databases, data pipelines, structured and unstructured data, and data quality.
 Experience monitoring and troubleshooting production applications.
 Ability to independently move from loosely defined business requirements to working technical solutions.
 
 Preferred Qualificat ions
 Experience with Microsoft Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, AKS, or similar cloud technologies.
 Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility.
 Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Cloud Run, Vertex AI, and related features.
 Experience building AI agents or agentic workflows.
 Experience with orchestration frameworks and AI application development patterns.
 Experience with vector databases and enterprise search/retrieval architectures.
 Experience with MLflow or equivalent model lifecycle tooling.
 Experience with Docker and containerized application deployment.
 Experience integrating AI with platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Databricks, Snowflake, SharePoint, or Microsoft Teams.
 Familiarity with LLM evaluation, observability, responsible AI, and AI security practices.
 Experience working in manufacturing, supply chain, industrial automation, engineering, finance, or other complex enterprise environments.
 
 What Success Looks Lik e
 Success in this role is measured primarily by AI capabilities running reliably in production and delivering business outcomes, not the number of prototypes created.

 A strong AI/ML Engineer will:
 Turn promising AI concepts into production solutions.
 Ship working capabilities frequently rather than allowing projects to remain in proof-of-concept mode.
 Build solutions that are secure, observable, maintainable, and supportable.
 Reduce the time required to move from business requirement to production.
 Create reusable AI engineering patterns that accelerate future projects.
 Resolve technical problems directly rather than continually handing them to other teams.
 Improve production solutions based on measurable usage, quality, reliability, cost, and business results.
 
 Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa now or in the future.
